headline: Blue Origin outlines New Glenn launch infrastructure upgrades
summary: Blue Origin outlines New Glenn launch infrastructure upgrades
Three Chinese reusable launch startups emerge with diverse rocket designs and funding
Axiom CEO satisfied with NASA RFP for commercial space stations
Musk blames India’s oligarchs, New Delhi cites security and the villages keep waiting

global.title: Blue Origin outlines New Glenn launch infrastructure upgrades
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Blue Origin plans to build additional launch pads and landing platform ships as part of investments needed to enable a much higher cadence of New Glenn launches from Florida.

global.title: Axiom CEO satisfied with NASA RFP for commercial space stations
global.summary: WASHINGTON — NASA’s call for proposals for a commercial space station development program addresses concerns raised by industry, one executive says, but the agency needs to do more to reduce requirements in general.

global.title: Musk blames India’s oligarchs, New Delhi cites security and the villages keep waiting
global.summary: Late on October 7, Elon Musk complained on X that “certain oligarchs” were keeping Starlink out of India, and the next day he asked, by name , whether Mukesh Ambani really runs the country. India’s communications ministry answered that all three licensed satellite operators sit at the same stage of review, that security checks are still under way for all of them, and it called the charge “baseless and misconceived.”
